question: Which radix regroupings of the identical prime candidate domain can lower the original m2 highest-form vanishing degree?

claims.text: Enumerate every partition of27; compute exact Hilbert data when socle<=40 and rigorous lower bounds otherwise, preserving all records and native byte replay.
No affine FFD/LFD, higher-m degree, runtime improvement or new point-base claim.

arms.description: The single all-ones partition reproduces the original Boolean presentation

parameters.partition_rule: at least one part greater than1

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact computations only; no clock or statistical comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Preproduction explicit F2/F3 controls retain39 nonmaximal maps; source mutation and four invalid digit-input tests reject invalid inputs. No statistical null population.
